recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間幾乎被造血細胞填滿、脂肪很少，屬於高細胞密度骨髓；此倍率無法看出顆粒球成熟停滯，需高倍或抹片確認。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow filling intertrabecular spaces with few fat vacuoles
Anastomosing bony trabeculae without significant remodeling
Scattered megakaryocytes visible as larger cells
Cellular detail not resolvable at low power
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly hypercellular marrow filling the spaces between anastomosing bony trabeculae, with few residual fat vacuoles and scattered megakaryocytes. Cytologic detail and myeloid maturation cannot be evaluated at this magnification. A hypercellular marrow is compatible with the myeloid hyperplasia and maturation arrest of severe congenital neutropenia but is nonspecific without higher-power and aspirate evaluation.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows complete maturation to segmented neutrophils at high power.
MPN shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis with a driver mutation.
Leukemia shows effacement by monotonous blasts at high power.
